cycle: Standard Time per Piece (Sec) — filled in from the Part when picked, can be changed for the day, and may be left blank (PACKING has none).
shift: Assembly Working Hours = Assembly End Time − Assembly Start Time
idealQty: Ideal Quantity = Assembly Working Hours × 3600 ÷ Standard Time per Piece — not rounded down; blank without a Standard Time.
rejectedQty: Rejected QTY = Total Defects = Wrong Assembly + Broken Screw + Wrong Clamping + Other. The breakdown shows each.
pctOk: % OK Quantity = OK Quantity ÷ (OK Quantity + Rejected Quantity)
unutilized: Unutilized Machine Time = (12 − (Shift Hours − Lunch ÷ 60)) ÷ 11, with Shift Hours and Lunch added up across every entry of this machine's date — so every entry of that machine/date shows the same figure. Shown as 0% when the result is below 0 and 100% when it is above 100.
totalStoppage: Total Idle (Min) = Lunch / Tea / Washroom + Other
effective: Effective Assembly Time (hr) = Total QTY × Standard Time per Piece ÷ 3600 — every piece counts; 0 without a Standard Time.
unreported: Unreported (min) = Planned Operator Shift × 60 − Effective time × 60 − Other Activity − Total Idle, for this entry (with Process Master's fixed shift: combined across the worker's whole date).
setupEff: Setup Efficiency = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ Machine Shift Time
oeeLosses: OEE considering losses = Effective Run Time ÷ (Available Hours − Total Downtime ÷ 60), combined across every entry of this machine's date.
oeeLunch: OEE not considering losses but lunch = Effective Run Time ÷ (Available Hours − Lunch ÷ 60), combined across every entry of this machine's date.
oeeLunchCot: OEE not considering losses but lunch and setup time = Effective Run Time ÷ (Available Hours − Lunch ÷ 60 − Setup Time ÷ 60), combined across every entry of this machine's date.
availability: Availability = Operating Time ÷ Planned Production Time, for this entry. Operating Time = Working Hours − Total Idle − Other Activity; Planned Production Time = Planned Operator Shift − Lunch / Tea. Above 100% (red) sends the entry to Admin review.
performance: Performance = Standard Time per Piece × Total QTY ÷ Operating Time, for this entry (blank without a Standard Time). Above 100% (red) sends the entry to Admin review.
quality: Quality = OK QTY ÷ Total QTY, for this entry.
review: Admin review: an entry whose Availability, Performance or Quality is above 100% is held as Pending review until an Admin or Super Admin approves or rejects it. Editing the figures sends it back for review; hover for details.
idealQtyPerHour: Ideal Quantity/Hour = 3600 ÷ Standard Time per Piece
totalDefect: Total Defects = Wrong Assembly + Broken Screw + Wrong Clamping + Other
okQty: OK QTY = Total QTY − Total Defects
productivity: Productivity without considering Lunch, tea, etc. = Effective time ÷ (Planned Operator Shift − Other Activity), for this entry (with Process Master's fixed shift: combined across the worker's whole date).
productivityLunch: Productivity considering Lunch, tea, etc. = Effective time ÷ (Planned Operator Shift − Other Activity − Lunch / Tea), for this entry (with Process Master's fixed shift: combined across the worker's whole date).
